```{r data}
curve_files <- list(
  usa = "usa-bs.csv",
  gbr = "gbr-bs.csv",
  jpn = "jpn-bs.csv",
  cad = "cad-bs.csv",
  ger = "ger-bs.csv",
  fra = "fra-bs.csv"
)

curves <- names(curve_files)
mats <- c(1, 3, 6, 12, 24, 60, 84, 120, 240, 360)

start_date <- as.Date("2010-01-01")
end_date <- as.Date("2020-12-31")
lambdas <- seq(0.01, 0.15, by = 0.005)
cutoffs <- c(4, 8)
reference_curve <- "usa"

yields <- lapply(curve_files, function(file_name) {
  read.csv(here::here("reconstructed_data", file_name), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
})

yields <- lapply(yields, function(curve_df) {
  curve_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      as.Date(time) >= start_date,
      as.Date(time) <= end_date
    )
})

years <- 2010:2020

annual_yields <- setNames(lapply(years, function(year) {
  lapply(yields, function(curve_df) {
    curve_df %>%
      dplyr::filter(format(as.Date(time), "%Y") == as.character(year))
  })
}), years)
```

```{r helpers}
extract_mc_component <- function(fit_obj, component) {
  if (!is.null(fit_obj[[component]])) {
    return(fit_obj[[component]])
  }

  if (!is.null(fit_obj$baseline_fit[[component]])) {
    return(fit_obj$baseline_fit[[component]])
  }

  stop("Component `", component, "` is not available in the supplied fit object.")
}

extract_annual_mc_estimates <- function(annual_mc_fits, component = c("curve", "shocked_curve", "tenor", "shocked_tenor")) {
  component <- match.arg(component)

  setNames(lapply(annual_mc_fits, function(fit_obj) {
    extract_mc_component(fit_obj, component) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(time = as.Date(time)) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(time)
  }), names(annual_mc_fits))
}

fit_annual_mc_models <- function(annual_yields, mats, lambdas, cutoffs, curves, reference,
                                 fit_spec, seed = NULL) {
  if (!is.null(seed)) {
    set.seed(seed)
  }

  setNames(lapply(annual_yields, function(yield_window) {
    mc_fit_shock_baseline(
      yields = yield_window,
      lambdas = lambdas,
      cutoffs = cutoffs,
      reference = reference,
      curves = curves,
      mats = mats,
      X_trunc = fit_spec$x_trunc,
      Xt_smooth = fit_spec$xt_smooth,
      smoother = fit_spec$smoother,
      CR_S0_shrink_diag = fit_spec$cov_shrink_diag
    )
  }), names(annual_yields))
}

fit_annual_shocked_mc_models <- function(annual_baseline_fits, shock_spec, fit_spec, seed = NULL) {
  if (!is.null(seed)) {
    set.seed(seed)
  }

  setNames(lapply(annual_baseline_fits, function(baseline_fit) {
    mc_fit_shock_from_baseline(
      baseline_state = baseline_fit,
      shock_curves = shock_spec$shock_curves,
      shock_factors = shock_spec$shock_factors,
      shock_magnitude = shock_spec$shock_magnitude,
      shock_type = shock_spec$shock_type,
      shock_window = shock_spec$shock_window,
      reuse_BS0 = fit_spec$reuse_bs0,
      reuse_ECM = fit_spec$reuse_ecm
    )
  }), names(annual_baseline_fits))
}

align_curve_panels <- function(lhs_panel, rhs_panel) {
  lhs_panel <- lhs_panel %>%
    dplyr::mutate(time = as.Date(time)) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(time)

  rhs_panel <- rhs_panel %>%
    dplyr::mutate(time = as.Date(time)) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(time)

  common_time <- intersect(lhs_panel$time, rhs_panel$time)
  common_cols <- setdiff(intersect(colnames(lhs_panel), colnames(rhs_panel)), "time")

  list(
    time = common_time,
    lhs = lhs_panel[match(common_time, lhs_panel$time), common_cols, drop = FALSE],
    rhs = rhs_panel[match(common_time, rhs_panel$time), common_cols, drop = FALSE]
  )
}

compute_annual_shock_effects <- function(baseline_panels, shocked_panels) {
  setNames(lapply(names(shocked_panels), function(year_label) {
    aligned <- align_curve_panels(
      lhs_panel = shocked_panels[[year_label]],
      rhs_panel = baseline_panels[[year_label]]
    )

    effect_panel <- data.frame(
      time = aligned$time,
      aligned$lhs - aligned$rhs,
      check.names = FALSE
    )
    colnames(effect_panel) <- c("time", colnames(aligned$lhs))
    effect_panel
  }), names(shocked_panels))
}

summarize_annual_shock_effects <- function(effect_panels) {
  purrr::imap_dfr(effect_panels, function(effect_panel, year_label) {
    effect_panel %>%
      tidyr::pivot_longer(
        cols = -time,
        names_to = "series",
        values_to = "effect"
      ) %>%
      tidyr::separate(series, into = c("curve", "tenor"), sep = "\\.", remove = FALSE) %>%
      dplyr::group_by(curve, tenor) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(
        year = as.integer(year_label),
        mean_effect = mean(effect, na.rm = TRUE),
        mean_abs_effect = mean(abs(effect), na.rm = TRUE),
        max_abs_effect = max(abs(effect), na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
  })
}

compute_annual_curve_differences <- function(annual_panels, selected_tenors) {
  tenor_labels <- sapply(selected_tenors, numeric_to_matname, USE.NAMES = FALSE)

  purrr::imap_dfr(annual_panels, function(panel_df, year_label) {
    panel_df %>%
      dplyr::mutate(time = as.Date(time)) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(time) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        dplyr::across(
          -time,
          ~ .x - dplyr::lag(.x)
        )
      ) %>%
      tidyr::pivot_longer(
        cols = -time,
        names_to = "series",
        values_to = "daily_diff"
      ) %>%
      tidyr::separate(series, into = c("curve", "tenor"), sep = "\\.", remove = FALSE) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(tenor = sub("^X", "", tenor)) %>%
      dplyr::filter(tenor %in% tenor_labels) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(year = as.integer(year_label)) %>%
      dplyr::filter(!is.na(daily_diff))
  })
}

build_shock_diff_scenarios <- function(scenario_panels, selected_tenors) {
  purrr::imap_dfr(scenario_panels, function(annual_panels, scenario_label) {
    compute_annual_curve_differences(
      annual_panels = annual_panels,
      selected_tenors = selected_tenors
    ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(scenario = scenario_label)
  })
}

build_level_shock_specs <- function(curve_name, magnitude_map, shock_factor = "L",
                                    shock_type = "additive", shock_window = NULL) {
  setNames(lapply(seq_along(magnitude_map), function(i) {
    list(
      shock_curves = curve_name,
      shock_factors = shock_factor,
      shock_magnitude = unname(magnitude_map[[i]]),
      shock_type = shock_type,
      shock_window = shock_window
    )
  }), names(magnitude_map))
}

fit_shock_spec_grid <- function(annual_baseline_fits, shock_specs, fit_spec, seed = NULL) {
  setNames(lapply(shock_specs, function(shock_spec) {
    fit_annual_shocked_mc_models(
      annual_baseline_fits = annual_baseline_fits,
      shock_spec = shock_spec,
      fit_spec = fit_spec,
      seed = seed
    )
  }), names(shock_specs))
}

stack_annual_curve_panels <- function(annual_panels, value_name = "value") {
  purrr::imap_dfr(annual_panels, function(panel_df, year_label) {
    panel_df %>%
      dplyr::mutate(time = as.Date(time)) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(time) %>%
      tidyr::pivot_longer(
        cols = -time,
        names_to = "series",
        values_to = value_name
      ) %>%
      tidyr::separate(series, into = c("curve", "tenor"), sep = "\\.", remove = FALSE) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        year = as.integer(year_label),
        tenor_month = as.integer(round(
          vapply(tenor, function(x) matname_to_numeric(sub("^X", "", x)) * 12, numeric(1))
        )),
        tenor_label = format_month_tenor_labels(tenor_month)
      )
  })
}

compute_pooled_yield_volatility <- function(annual_panels) {
  stack_annual_curve_panels(annual_panels, value_name = "yield") %>%
    dplyr::group_by(year, curve, tenor, tenor_month, tenor_label) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(time, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(daily_change = yield - dplyr::lag(yield)) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(daily_change)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(curve, tenor, tenor_month, tenor_label) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      yield_volatility = stats::sd(daily_change, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

compute_pooled_rmse <- function(effect_panels) {
  stack_annual_curve_panels(effect_panels, value_name = "effect") %>%
    dplyr::group_by(curve, tenor, tenor_month, tenor_label) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      rmse = sqrt(mean(effect^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

compute_relative_spillover <- function(effect_panels, reference_curve) {
  effect_norms <- stack_annual_curve_panels(effect_panels, value_name = "effect") %>%
    dplyr::group_by(curve, tenor, tenor_month, tenor_label) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      effect_norm = sqrt(sum(effect^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  reference_norms <- effect_norms %>%
    dplyr::filter(curve == reference_curve) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      tenor,
      tenor_month,
      tenor_label,
      reference_norm = effect_norm
    )

  effect_norms %>%
    dplyr::left_join(reference_norms, by = c("tenor", "tenor_month", "tenor_label")) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      relative_spillover = dplyr::if_else(
        is.na(reference_norm) | reference_norm == 0,
        NA_real_,
        effect_norm / reference_norm
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(curve, tenor, tenor_month, tenor_label, relative_spillover)
}

build_metric_scenario_table <- function(scenario_panels, metric_builder) {
  purrr::imap_dfr(scenario_panels, function(annual_panels, scenario_label) {
    metric_builder(annual_panels) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(scenario = scenario_label, .before = 1)
  })
}

build_effect_scenario_table <- function(scenario_panels, baseline_panels, effect_builder) {
  purrr::imap_dfr(scenario_panels, function(annual_panels, scenario_label) {
    effect_panels <- compute_annual_shock_effects(
      baseline_panels = baseline_panels,
      shocked_panels = annual_panels
    )

    effect_builder(effect_panels) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(scenario = scenario_label, .before = 1)
  })
}

reshape_metric_table <- function(metric_df, value_col, curves, mats, scenario_levels) {
  tenor_order <- format_month_tenor_labels(mats)

  metric_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      curve = factor(curve, levels = curves),
      tenor_label = factor(tenor_label, levels = tenor_order),
      scenario = factor(scenario, levels = scenario_levels)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(curve, tenor_label, scenario) %>%
    dplyr::select(curve, tenor = tenor_label, scenario, value = dplyr::all_of(value_col)) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = scenario, values_from = value) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(curve, tenor)
}

sample_boxplot_outliers <- function(plot_df, max_outliers_per_group = 24, seed = 999) {
  set.seed(seed)

  plot_df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(tenor, scenario) %>%
    dplyr::group_modify(function(.x, .y) {
      whisker_stats <- boxplot.stats(.x$daily_diff)$stats
      outliers <- .x %>%
        dplyr::filter(
          daily_diff < whisker_stats[[1]] |
            daily_diff > whisker_stats[[5]]
        )

      if (nrow(outliers) > max_outliers_per_group) {
        outliers <- dplyr::slice_sample(outliers, n = max_outliers_per_group)
      }

      outliers
    }) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()
}

format_month_tenor_labels <- function(tenor_months) {
  paste0(as.integer(tenor_months), "M")
}

plot_shock_diff_boxplots <- function(diff_panel, country_code, tenor_order, tenor_labels,
                                     scenario_levels, y_limit = 4,
                                     max_outliers_per_group = 24, outlier_seed = 999) {
  country_panel <- diff_panel %>%
    dplyr::filter(curve == country_code, tenor %in% tenor_order) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      tenor = factor(tenor, levels = tenor_order, labels = tenor_labels),
      scenario = factor(scenario, levels = scenario_levels)
    )

  sampled_outliers <- sample_boxplot_outliers(
    plot_df = country_panel,
    max_outliers_per_group = max_outliers_per_group,
    seed = outlier_seed
  )

  ggplot(country_panel, aes(x = scenario, y = daily_diff, fill = scenario)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey55", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_boxplot(
      notch = TRUE,
      outlier.shape = NA,
      width = 0.7
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = sampled_outliers,
      aes(x = scenario, y = daily_diff),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      position = position_jitter(width = 0.12, height = 0),
      alpha = 0.45,
      size = 0.9,
      shape = 16,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ tenor, ncol = 2) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-y_limit, y_limit)) +
    labs(
      title = toupper(country_code),
      x = NULL,
      y = "Daily Curve Difference"
    ) +
    scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2", guide = "none") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
}
```

```{r fit-specs}
fit_seed <- 999

usa_shock_magnitudes <- c(
  `[USA] 50` = 0.5,
  `[USA] 100` = 1.0,
  `[USA] 200` = 2.0
)

jpn_shock_magnitudes <- c(
  `[JPN] 25` = 0.25,
  `[JPN] 50` = 0.5,
  `[JPN] 100` = 1.0
)

shock_run_spec_usa <- build_level_shock_specs("usa", usa_shock_magnitudes)
shock_run_spec_jpn <- build_level_shock_specs("jpn", jpn_shock_magnitudes)
shock_scenario_levels <- c("Baseline", names(shock_run_spec_usa), names(shock_run_spec_jpn))

mc_run_spec <- list(
  reuse_bs0 = TRUE,
  reuse_ecm = TRUE,
  x_trunc = TRUE,
  xt_smooth = FALSE,
  smoother = NULL,
  cov_shrink_diag = 0.4
)

```

```{r fit-baseline-mc}
baseline_mc_annual_fits <- fit_annual_mc_models(
  annual_yields = annual_yields,
  mats = mats,
  lambdas = lambdas,
  cutoffs = cutoffs,
  curves = curves,
  reference = reference_curve,
  fit_spec = mc_run_spec,
  seed = fit_seed
)

annual_baseline_curve_estimates <- extract_annual_mc_estimates(
  baseline_mc_annual_fits,
  component = "curve"
)
```

```{r fit-shocked-mc}
shock_mc_annual_fits_usa <- fit_shock_spec_grid(
  annual_baseline_fits = baseline_mc_annual_fits,
  shock_specs = shock_run_spec_usa,
  fit_spec = mc_run_spec,
  seed = fit_seed
)

shock_mc_annual_fits_jpn <- fit_shock_spec_grid(
  annual_baseline_fits = baseline_mc_annual_fits,
  shock_specs = shock_run_spec_jpn,
  fit_spec = mc_run_spec,
  seed = fit_seed
)
```

```{r shock-effects}
annual_shocked_curve_estimates <- extract_annual_mc_estimates(
  shock_mc_annual_fits_usa[["[USA] 100"]],
  component = "shocked_curve"
)

annual_shocked_tenor_estimates <- extract_annual_mc_estimates(
  shock_mc_annual_fits_usa[["[USA] 100"]],
  component = "shocked_tenor"
)

annual_shock_effect_panels <- compute_annual_shock_effects(
  baseline_panels = annual_baseline_curve_estimates,
  shocked_panels = annual_shocked_curve_estimates
)

annual_shock_effect_summary <- summarize_annual_shock_effects(annual_shock_effect_panels)

shock_effect_table <- annual_shock_effect_summary %>%
  dplyr::group_by(curve, tenor) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_effect = mean(mean_effect, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_abs_effect = mean(mean_abs_effect, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_abs_effect = max(max_abs_effect, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(curve, match(tenor, sapply(mats, numeric_to_matname, USE.NAMES = FALSE)))
```

```{r shock-diff-boxplots}
selected_plot_tenors <- c(3, 12, 120, 360)
selected_plot_tenor_keys <- sapply(selected_plot_tenors, numeric_to_matname, USE.NAMES = FALSE)
selected_plot_tenor_labels <- format_month_tenor_labels(selected_plot_tenors)

  list(Baseline = annual_baseline_curve_estimates),
  setNames(lapply(shock_mc_annual_fits_usa, extract_annual_mc_estimates, component = "shocked_curve"), names(shock_mc_annual_fits_usa)),
  setNames(lapply(shock_mc_annual_fits_jpn, extract_annual_mc_estimates, component = "shocked_curve"), names(shock_mc_annual_fits_jpn))
```
